chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'a, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Basir, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: In the case of six siblings and a grandfather, he said, 'For the grandfather is one-sixth.'
ai.seo_question: What is the share of the paternal grandfather in inheritance when he is present with six siblings?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the male paternal grandfather receives one-sixth of the estate when competing with six siblings, a ruling that highlights the specific hierarchy in Shia inheritance jurisprudence. This narration is pivotal for understanding the 'blocking' (hijr) mechanism, where the presence of descendants or specific ascendants affects the grandfather's share, distinguishing it from the Sunni view where he may receive one-sixth or the residue depending on the presence of parents. The ruling underscores the precision of the Ahl al-Bayt's legal methodology in resolving complex fractional shares within the Quranic framework.
